description: What the app's merge tests read from GitHub, recorded from the app on generation 6 of fixtures/merge.sh's pull requests, rozed-dev/e2e#192 to #208: #192, ready, its panel opened and stepped through the methods to a squash, which read the commit GitHub would write; #202, blocked by e4/gated's rules, its panel opened and its failed check's run opened; #196, a draft; #206, first in e4/queued's queue, which rozed-bot added it to, and the queue, which listed it; #203, waiting for an approval with auto-merge on, which rozed-bot turned on; and #192 again with no account. Each tab stayed open long enough for its polls to repeat. rozed-bot then took #206 out of the queue and turned #203's auto-merge off, so neither merged.
